g1-diagnose.title: G1 Root-cause the k-instability (evidence-only diagnosis + decide-fix)
g1-diagnose.imperative: REASONING GATE (crew-waiver: deliverable is a diagnosis + a fix decision I hold full context for; no production-module code changes here; verified by me reproducing the key numbers). Write a diagnostic script under .agent-work/638-f12-stability-rework/ that reads C:/Programs/f1Brainz/data/damage_integrals.db grip_bin_obs READ-ONLY and characterizes WHY k is unstable across circuit-composition splits: (a) is BIC monotone-decreasing in k at ~300k rows (under-regularized, chases fine structure)?; (b) is the support floor jumping k around?; (c) are the component LOCATIONS (universal corner-type centroids) actually stable even when k differs?; (d) empirically test the candidate fixes in launch-order preference order (sample-size-robust / subsampled or effective-N selection; held-out/CV selection; narrower/regularized k_range) and, only if those fail, circuit-conditional/hierarchical — measure per-split matched-k AND sub-threshold component_agreement_stat across the 5 F12 splits for each candidate. Pick the SIMPLEST fix that earns matched-k + locations < F12_AGREEMENT_THRESHOLD on all 5 splits with k STILL support-driven (not a hardcoded constant), ideally leaving mixture_stability.py's gate frozen. Record the diagnosis + chosen fix + evidence to .agent-work/638-f12-stability-rework/DIAGNOSIS.md. Decide-fix: reconcile the choice against the launch order's preference order and cite it (attach c2 user-decision); FLOAT to the Admiral (write in verdict + STOP) ONLY if the instability proves fundamental (no fix earns a genuine pass) OR the only pass requires weakening the F12 gate below falsifiable. git checkout -- data/ after any DB-touching run. Attest c1, attach c2.

g2-implement.title: G2 Implement the G1-selected fix + tests
g2-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md from DIAGNOSIS.md's chosen fix. Implement it in src/physics/layer2/property_mixture.py (and mixture_stability.py ONLY if the fix genuinely requires it — prefer leaving the gate frozen). Any new selection constant is FROZEN in-module with a domain-reasoned comment (chosen before the real-data run, not tuned to it). Keep k support-driven. Update/extend tests: tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_property_mixture.py and test_mixture_stability.py — the discriminating synthetic test (stable→PASS, shifted→FAIL) MUST still pass unchanged in intent; add coverage for the new selection behavior; add a synthetic test showing large-N no longer over-selects k; and add a MECHANICAL support-driven-k test proving k RESPONDS UPWARD to a genuine well-supported added cluster (and down with fewer) so a k-pinned-in-all-but-name fix fails CI (critic finding #4). MAY edit scripts/f12_held_out_stability.py / scripts/build_regime_rollup.py ONLY if the fix needs a default-valued param plumbed through (callers unaffected). Run py -m src.utils.simplification_limits on touched paths. Do NOT run the ~6-min real-data F12 here (commander owns that foreground in G3) — prove correctness via fast synthetic/unit tests. Dispatch constellation-implementer; integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

Then in the MAIN repo: git -C C:/Programs/f1Brainz checkout -- data/ if the DB dir shows changes; confirm no data/*.db staged in EITHER repo. If honestly STILL-FALSIFIED after the fix: do NOT fudge — block this gate and FLOAT to the Admiral (write the still-falsified diagnosis into the verdict). Attest c3.
